commits.message:
refactor: use gh aw logs for token analysis workflows (#1884)

Replace manual artifact downloading (gh run download --name firewall-audit-logs)
with gh aw logs --json in all 4 token analysis workflows. This aligns with
the approach used by gh-aw's own token-audit and token-optimizer workflows.

Benefits:
- Eliminates dependency on knowing the correct artifact name
  (the root cause of the bug fixed in PR #1883)
- Gets pre-aggregated structured data (token counts, costs, turns)
  instead of parsing raw token-usage.jsonl
- Handles artifact naming backward/forward compat automatically
- Pre-downloads data in steps block (faster, more reliable)

Changes:
- copilot-token-usage-analyzer.md: replaced manual run discovery +
  artifact download with gh aw logs --engine copilot --json pre-step
- claude-token-usage-analyzer.md: same for --engine claude
- copilot-token-optimizer.md: added gh aw logs --engine copilot
  pre-step for 7-day data, removed manual artifact download
- claude-token-optimizer.md: same for --engine claude
- shared/mcp/gh-aw.md: new shared component to install gh-aw CLI
  (mirroring upstream gh-aw's shared/mcp/gh-aw.md)

Refs: #1883, github/gh-aw#25683

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* api-proxy: log billing/quota response headers and X-Initiator sent

Extract X-Quota-Snapshot-* headers (PRU entitlement, overage, remaining)
and rate-limit headers from upstream CAPI responses. Include them in:
- request_complete structured log (for real-time visibility)
- token-usage JSONL records (for offline billing analysis)

Also logs the X-Initiator value that was sent on the request so operators
can correlate billing treatment with initiator tagging.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* schemas: add x_initiator and billing fields to token-usage schema

Document the new optional fields added to token-usage.jsonl records:
- x_initiator: the X-Initiator header value sent (agent/user)
- billing: parsed X-Quota-Snapshot-* and X-RateLimit-* response headers

These fields enable offline analysis of PRU billing behavior.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix(ci): increase one-shot-token test timeouts for Docker build

The container-mode tests use buildLocal: true which triggers a full
Docker image build. On CI without cached layers, the first 2-3 tests
hit the 60s AWF timeout (execa kills process → exit code -1) because
Docker build alone takes ~55-60s.

- AWF timeout: 60000 → 180000ms (3 minutes)
- Jest timeout: 120000 → 240000ms (4 minutes)

The chroot-mode tests pass quickly (14s) because images are already
built by then.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix(ci): make audit artifacts world-readable to prevent EACCES in gh-aw post-run

The gh-aw post-run audit step runs as the 'runner' user but AWF creates
audit files as root with mode 0600. When AWF cleanup is interrupted
(SIGKILL from timeout), the chmod a+rX never runs, leaving files
unreadable and causing:

  EACCES: permission denied, stat 'docker-compose.redacted.yml'

Fix: Create audit files with mode 0644 (dir 0755) from the start. These
files contain no secrets — squid.conf has only domain ACLs, compose is
redacted, and policy-manifest is just firewall rules.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix(ci): increase smoke workflow timeouts from 5 to 15 minutes

With --build-local, Docker image builds take 7+ minutes on cold cache
(no layer cache on CI runners). The 5-minute step timeout causes the
Copilot CLI execution step to be killed before the agent even starts.

Increase timeout-minutes from 5 to 15 in:
- smoke-copilot-byok (md + lock)
- smoke-copilot (md + lock)
- smoke-gemini (md only, lock was already 15)

ci: use github.token for copilot-engine workflows (drop removed COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN secret) (#6556)

* ci: add copilot-requests perm, use github.token for copilot engine

The COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN secret was removed from the repo, causing every
copilot-engine workflow that referenced secrets.COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN to
send an empty token to the api-proxy and get HTTP 401 from
api.githubcopilot.com. Adding the copilot-requests: write permission lets
gh-aw compile the built-in github.token as COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN instead,
removing the dependency on the deleted secret.

* ci: fix BYOK copilot token source
